title: UI风格#49 - Nordic Frost (北欧霜冻)
description: 创建第49种UI风格：北欧霜冻风格 - 冰霜质感、冷色调、极简几何。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planAW.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Frost style When color palette Then features ice blue, frost white, slate gray, aurora accents
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: #E8F4F8 (冰蓝), #F0F8FF (霜白), #708090 (板岩灰), #00CED1 (极光青), #1C3946 (深冰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Frost style When typography Then uses clean nordic fonts: Montserrat, Fira Sans, or Nunito Sans
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Montserrat (标题), Fira Sans (正文)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Frost style When layout Then frost patterns, ice crystals, fjord-inspired geometry
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: frost overlay with radial gradients, aurora line divider, clean white gradient background

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Frost style When UI elements Then frost glass, ice textures, crystalline shapes
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: frosted glass cards with blur(15-20px), subtle ice-blue borders, rounded 15-20px corners

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Frost UI When functional Then includes frost chat, nordic agents, ice stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: nordic terminal chat, 4 viking cards (Viking/Aurora/Fjord/Glacial) with frost stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Frost UI When copy Then uses arctic nature: 'Frost', 'Ice', 'Nordic', 'Frozen'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'FROST. ICE. FJORD.', button 'CHILL', status 'Active'/'Frozen', nav 'Home'/'Workbench'
